'''Merl Terll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Racer/Legends|ex-racer]] who won many times the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]] with his partner [[Honest Grek]]. After a crash, his wife [[Babs Terll|Babs]] asked him to not race again.
